top1.title: 【2026-11-05】ChatGPTがGIF生成に対応、Images 2.6で画像生成も高速化
top1.lead1: ChatGPTが文章やアップロードした写真からGIFを生成できるようになりました。
top1.lead2: 再生速度や個別フレームの編集にも対応。Images 2.6では画像生成も高速化するとしています。

top10.title: [2026-11-05] ChatGPT adds GIF generation; Images 2.6 also speeds up image generation
top10.summary: OpenAI is rolling out Images 2.6. ChatGPT can generate GIFs from text or photos and let users edit playback speed and individual frames.

top10.title: [2026-11-05] Google's plan to tie school search access to AI draws backlash, with freedom of choice at issue
top10.summary: Critics objected to a policy under which restricting AI in schools would also disable search. Google explained that Search and services such as Gemini can be enabled separately.

top10.title: [2026-11-05] Nothing to ship its first screenless AI device in December
top10.summary: Nothing CEO Carl Pei previewed the company's first AI-native product. He described it as a screenless device that offers something an app cannot deliver.

top10.title: [2026-11-05] [Hands-on review] Apple's Siri Recaps: convenient conversation summaries, but concerns over constant recording
top10.summary: TechCrunch tried Apple Watch's conversation summary feature. While it can preserve important points, the publication cited the recording of unwanted conversations and the mixing of topics as problems.

editorsDesk.recTitle: 米国政府、AnthropicにFable 5/Mythos 5の海外アクセス停止命令
editorsDesk.recNote: 輸出規制によりFable 5とMythos 5の全世界・外国アクセスが停止。AI地政学の新局面を象徴する事態。
editorsDesk.bonusNote: 今日のおまけアニメ。クリックで再生。
